column1: # One line per dynamically-loadable grammar (src/treesitter.cpp's own
# DynamicLanguageTable) -- everything mep can highlight beyond its small
# compiled-in core set (see third_party/README.md), which this list gets
# to parity with without needing Nix. Columns, tab-separated:
#                     exactly, since that's also the .so filename
#   repo              GitHub "owner/repo", source of truth for every rev
#                      non-Nix paths build the same grammars).
#   rev                a tag or commit SHA -- whatever that repo actually
#                       has; fetched via GitHub's codeload tarball, which
#   subdir             empty for a normal single-grammar repo; set when
#                       the repo bundles more than one grammar (e.g.
# perl intentionally points at ganezdragon/tree-sitter-perl, not the
# one ships no committed src/parser.c (would need the tree-sitter CLI to
# generate one, the exact "not vendorable without extra tooling" case
# third_party/README.md already documents for sql/latex/swift). mep's own
# ganezdragon's grammar's own node types for exactly this reason -- don't
# repoint this line at the other repo without rewriting that query too.
# vue points at a live default-branch commit, not the tag
# build resolves -- that tag was deleted upstream after nixpkgs pinned it
# (Nix still builds it fine, straight from cache.nixos.org's permanent
# binary cache, but a fresh git/curl fetch of that exact tag 404s live).
# To add another language: find its grammar repo (cross-check
# project's flake.lock is available -- the most reliable source, since
# nixpkgs has already done the "does this even ship a committed parser.c"
# legwork), add a row here, add a highlights.scm to
# src/treesitter_queries.h, and add a DynamicLanguageTable entry in
